name: MovieCORE
description: MovieCORE is a video question answering dataset designed to probe deeper cognitive understanding of movie content, emphasizing thought-provoking questions that require System 2 thinking. It includes a novel agentic brainstorming annotation approach and cognitive tests to assess dataset quality and VQA model performance.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the paper itself, so it has limited community adoption so far but is notable for introducing a more cognitively demanding movie-VQA setup.
notes: Focuses on deeper cognitive reasoning in movies; uses multiple LLMs for question generation and refinement.
